claims.text: The IPA labels data by augmenting resources with structured and labeled training data through user interactions.
User interactions help in creating structured dialogues that can be used for retraining dialogue units using Transfer Learning techniques.
The system preprocesses user input to normalize and correct it before labeling, which aids in entity extraction.
